shared_elements: low-relief carving on a pale stone slab
horizontal band or register dividing the surface
justification: Both are shallow reliefs on flat pale stone that organise motifs into bands or blocks and show heads/figures strictly in profile, and both include a horizontal patterned band crossing the field. But A is a sparse, heavily schematic scatter of animals with large empty ground and rough weathered surface, whereas B is a densely packed, finely detailed panel dominated by an ornately costumed standing human flanked by ordered columns of square sign-blocks — a wholly different level of detail, density and subject.
